title: T008 CI pipelines dispatched with runtime proof pending
summary: GitHub Actions proved the CI checks and T007 Docker Compose health, while the security workflow correctly blocked on HIGH/CRITICAL findings in the pinned Compose images.

claims.text: T008 CI frontend contract, Java quality/unit and Docker Compose integration jobs completed successfully.
T007 PostgreSQL, S3Mock and OIDC containers each reported healthy on the GitHub runner.
Dependency audit, CodeQL and filesystem Trivy scans completed successfully.
Trivy image scans reported HIGH/CRITICAL findings for postgres, s3mock and oidc, so the security gate is blocked.
T008 must remain unchecked and unmerged until the findings are remediated or an explicitly approved security exception is recorded.

decision.context: T007 was merged with explicit runtime-proof follow-up assigned to T008.
decision.chosen: Keep T008 unchecked and PR #25 unmerged; remediate the pinned Compose image findings or obtain explicit project-owner security approval.
alternatives: Mark T008 complete from static inspection only
tradeoffs: T007 runtime proof is now available
The security gate prevents falsely declaring T008 complete
A separate image-remediation decision is required
decision.invalidation: If the security findings are fixed and the full workflow rerun passes, update this record and reassess the T008 checkbox/merge gate.
